id: International Packraft Film Festival - Wellington-4 Moncrieff Street, Mount Victoria, Wellington 6011, New Zealand-Humanitix
name: International Packraft Film Festival - Wellington
venue: 4 Moncrieff Street, Mount Victoria, Wellington 6011, New Zealand
long_description:
Come along to a screening of the 2026 program of the International Packraft Film Festival. Join us for two hours of packrafting films, covering a range of themes from long expeditions to first descents to snow leopard conservation.
See the program description for a full list of the films.
Doors open 6pm, screening starts 6.30. Tea, coffee and biscuits provided at intermission.
Packrafters, kayakers, the paddle curious, all are welcome.
